name: OTel-Embedding-109M
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 514). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (MPNet), full attention, no causal mask, relative position bias
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28. A finetune of sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.109 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-02-02. CAVEAT: single in-domain telecom retrieval partition, no external benchmark transfer; the 38.5% base row is a general-purpose embedder scored on telecom text.

benchmarks.name: NDCG@10 (OTel telecom retrieval)
benchmarks.config: Card table 'OTel vs. Base Model': Base model 38.5% vs OTel fine-tuned 87.2% +/- 0.7, +48.7 pp, OTel-Embedding held-out 10% partition; bootstrap n=1000. In-domain telecom corpus.
